android.meta.title: TypeWhisper for Android
android.meta.description: TypeWhisper for Android: private speech-to-text with on-device engines, its own keyboard, a dictation bubble for any app, and writing profiles.
android.label: Android
android.title: TypeWhisper for Android
android.lede: Private speech-to-text for Android with on-device engines, its own keyboard, a dictation bubble for any app, and writing profiles.
android.get.label: Download
android.get.title: Get it on Google Play
android.get.lede: Install TypeWhisper like any other app. Updates arrive through Google Play.
android.features.label: Features
android.features.title: What TypeWhisper does on Android
android.features.lede: The core works without an account. With an on-device engine, the recording stays on your phone.
android.features.item1: On-device dictation with Parakeet (25 European languages), Whisper (99 languages), and other local models.
android.features.item2: The TypeWhisper keyboard for any app, with a QWERTZ or QWERTY layout.
android.features.item3: The dictation bubble: dictate into other apps while you keep your own keyboard.
android.features.item4: Optional cloud speech engines with your own API key.
android.features.item5: Writing profiles: Cleaned Text, Message, Email, Note, Calendar Event, Checklist, Summary, Translation, or your own.
android.features.item6: Quick dictations from the quick settings tile, the widget, an app shortcut, or the assist gesture, collected in the Inbox.
android.features.item8: Premium: the Email and Calendar Event formats, live transcription with Nemotron Live, and speaker detection.
android.beta.label: Beta program
android.beta.title: Try new versions early
android.beta.p1: New versions go to the beta program on Google Play first. Open the testing page with your Google account and tap Become a tester. Google Play then offers you the beta versions.
android.beta.p2: You can leave the beta program on the same page.
android.beta.p3: Send feedback in the app under Settings → Send feedback, on Discord, or by email.
android.beta.discordText: Questions, bugs, and ideas with other users and testers.
android.beta.emailText: Bug reports and anything you would rather not post publicly.
android.requirements.title: Requirements
android.requirements.text: A phone or tablet with Android 10 or later and Google Play.
